Publish markdown and return share links using curl. Support markdown with mermaid diagrams such as component diagrams, flowcharts, and sequence diagrams. Also supports KaTex and code blocks. AutEng will return a shareable link to the publi.

- Documented support for mermaid diagrams (component, flowcharts, sequence), KaTeX, and code blocks.

- Clarified response handling: treat any response missing share_url as an error and show the full JSON.
